# Scorecard development (generated by `make scorecard`)

Fitted on 36-month loans issued 2007-2014 (337,996 loans). Scale: 600 points = odds 50:1, 20 points double the odds. Possible scores: 484 to 603.

## Time cross-validation (Gini on the test year, training on all earlier years)

| test_year   |   up to 6 |   up to 9 |   up to 12 |
|:------------|----------:|----------:|-----------:|
| 2011        |     0.323 |     0.342 |      0.341 |
| 2012        |     0.278 |     0.292 |      0.293 |
| 2013        |     0.276 |     0.273 |      0.277 |
| 2014        |     0.275 |     0.292 |      0.296 |
| mean        |     0.288 |     0.3   |      0.302 |

Chosen: up to **9** characteristics (best mean Gini; a smaller scorecard wins within 0.005).
